Plot a timeseries from a given data extract

plot_timeseries.Rd

Sums a value column by year (YY) and, optionally, by a colouring and/or faceting variable, then draws the result as a line-and-point plot. Colours and facet labels are looked up from the package's internal lookups where available.

Usage

plot_timeseries(
  data,
  value_col = NULL,
  colour_by = NULL,
  facet_by = NULL,
  facet_scales = "fixed",
  y_lab = NULL,
  n_breaks = 5
)

Arguments

data

A tibble extracted from one of the fishextract::get_* functions. Must contain a YY column (year) and the column to be plotted.

value_col

<data-masking> Column to sum and plot on the y-axis, supplied unquoted. If NULL (default), it is detected from data: sum_catch_mt if present, otherwise n_vessels. An error is raised if neither is found.

colour_by

<data-masking> Optional column to group and colour the timeseries by, supplied unquoted. If NULL (default), a single series is drawn.

facet_by

<data-masking> Optional column to split the plot into facets by, supplied unquoted. If NULL (default), no faceting is applied.

facet_scales

Character string passed to ggplot2::facet_wrap(). One of "fixed" (default), "free", "free_x" or "free_y". Ignored when facet_by = NULL.

y_lab

Character string for the y-axis label. If NULL (default), "Catch (mt)" or "Number of vessels" is used when value_col is detected automatically, otherwise the name of value_col.

n_breaks

Integer. Approximate number of x-axis (year) breaks, passed to base::pretty(). Defaults to 5.

Value

A ggplot object.
